== Ingredients ==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) boneless, skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breast]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]] 
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] (15 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]] 
*3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (750 ml) [[Cookbook:Corn flakes|cornflakes]], crushed to make 1 ½ cups 
*1 ½ teaspoons (7.5 ml) jerk seasoning
*½ cup (125 ml) honey-mustard salad dressing
*1 teaspoon (5 ml) grated [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]] peel 
*2 [[Cookbook:Mango|mangoes]], seeded, peeled, and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]

== Procedure ==
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 450°F.
#Trim fat from chicken. 
#Cut chicken lengthwise into ¾ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]]-wide strips. 
#In shallow dish [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] together egg whites and honey. 
#In another shallow dish combine cereal and jerk seasoning. 
#Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture and then roll dipped pieces in cereal mixture. 
#Place the cereal-coated pieces in a single layer on an ungreased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]]. 
#[[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] at 450°F for 11–13 minutes or until tender and no longer pink. 
#While baking, in small bowl stir together salad dressing and lime peel. 
#Serve chicken and mango slices with salad dressing mixture. 

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*This recipe can also be served as an appetizer; it will make 12 servings. 
*Jerk seasoning can be bought ready-made or you can follow the recipe for [[Cookbook:Jamaican Jerk Spice|Jamaican jerk spice]]
